subject: Your dead leads list is not dead
html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Confession: the most valuable list at most service businesses is the one nobody opens.


It's the old leads. The quotes that went quiet. The “let me think about it” people.


Here's the old way.


Someone remembers to send a “just checking in” text… maybe once, maybe never.


Now…


The AI Growth Engine's way: every dead lead gets a personal, well-timed message — automatically.


It reads the history. Writes the follow-up. Sends it. And when someone replies, it books the call onto your calendar.


No chasing. No spreadsheet. No guilt about the list you never got to.


This works best for businesses that book 1:1 appointments and already have past leads sitting in a CRM, inbox, or phone. If that's not you, skip this one.


Want me to put together a custom AI + marketing plan for {{business_name}}? Book a quick discovery call — https://link.digigrowthllc.com/widget/booking/tydZBa2ehjdSRZopOMrn


Talk soon,
Dylan | Digigrowth


P.S. — this isn't a sales pitch, just 20 minutes to see if The AI Growth Engine is a fit.
